name: PartnerServiceAdd React rewrite: Screenshoty (Screenshots) tab
description:
## Why?

Screenshots are the only tab backed by real AJAX endpoints rather than the shared form POST: upload, delete and drag-to-reorder each hit their own action. It is the highest-risk tab of the rewrite because the file uploader and the priority-reorder interaction have to keep working exactly as before.

## What?

Port `sub/ServiceDetail/Screenshots.tpl` and the `sub/Uploader.tpl` include to React, remove its external-tab bridge entry and delete the legacy partials if this page is their last consumer.

Covers the image grid per image type and language, the `alts[imageId]` textarea per image, and three AJAX endpoints on `PartnerServiceAddController`: `adminUploadImageAction()`, `adminDeleteImageAction()`, `adminSetImagePrioritiesAction()`. Convert the actions to Ajax responses; URLs and business logic stay unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Upload works per image type and language via `/admin/action/PartnerServiceAdd/UploadImage/?id=...`, including validation and error rendering
- Delete works via `/admin/action/PartnerServiceAdd/DeleteImage/?imageid=...` with the legacy confirmation
- Drag reorder persists via `/admin/action/PartnerServiceAdd/SetImagePriorities/?ids=...`
- `alts[imageId]` saves with the main form
- Endpoint URLs, request shapes and response contracts unchanged
- Every `data-testid` from `Screenshots.tpl` preserved verbatim, no hardcoded strings
- `Screenshots.tpl` deleted and its bridge entry removed; `sub/Uploader.tpl` only deleted if no other live page consumes it
- `make check-fast`, `make lint`, `make fe-test` green
